lines.en: I call Imani to find that her plans for the afternoon are to basically just grade papers until she gets a migraine. And, sensing that she could use a break, I invite her out for coffee.
lines.zh: 我打给 Imani,发现她下午的计划基本上就是改作业改到偏头痛为止。察觉到她需要休息,我约她出去喝咖啡。

lines.en: What I did not know at the time of me doing this was that she would take it as an invitation to just grade papers beside me.
lines.zh: 我做这件事的当时并不知道,她会把这当作「在你旁边改作业」的邀请。

lines.en: And, after I take a few seconds to remind myself that this is simply what responsible teachers [[probably] do, I don't bother voicing any complaints.
lines.zh: 花了几秒提醒自己,负责任的教师 [[大概] 就是这么做的之后,我懒得提任何意见。

lines.en: I mean, how could I when the only reason she's working this hard to begin with is to make up for my absence?
lines.zh: 再说,我能怎么提?她这么拼命工作,起因本来就是填补我的缺位。

lines.en: I buy her a drink and a few pastries and keep quiet when she needs me to keep quiet, occasionally voicing an opinion on a topic she...requires an opinion in regard to.
lines.zh: 我给她买了饮料和几份点心,在她需要安静时保持安静,偶尔在她……需要意见的话题上,发表一点意见。

lines.en: But overall, it's just a relatively calm afternoon.
lines.zh: 总体而言,这只是个相对平静的下午。

lines.en: Eventually, she puts her notes and papers down and is able to start focusing on me.
lines.zh: 最终,她放下笔记和试卷,终于能开始专注于我。

lines.en: She apologizes and tells me about how crazy things have been lately. And how it's getting harder to hide the fact that I haven't been showing up.
lines.zh: 她道了歉,告诉我最近事情有多疯狂。以及,要隐瞒我一直没露面的事实,越来越难了。

lines.en: And while she never directly asks me to come back, it's easy to tell that she wants me to. And that's reinforced by several consecutive stories of how some of the girls are faring without me.
lines.zh: 虽然她从未直接开口要我回来,但不难看出她想。而接连几段「女孩们没有我过得如何」的故事,更坐实了这一点。

lines.en: She knows I still see them around sometimes. She hears about it while she's trying to teach.
lines.zh: 她知道我有时还会在附近露面。她上课的时候就会听说。

lines.en: But it's not the same....and no one thinks it is.
lines.zh: 但那不一样。……也没有人觉得一样。

lines.en: If only they knew how I felt.
lines.zh: 要是她们知道我的感受就好了。
Imani 的好感度提升到了 [imani_love]!
